description: the floating sphere of cfd_3d_heave_sphere_6dof (all six DOFs free) on two dynamic mooring lines (X 310 3, X 311: beams), the lines as .vtk files and in the LAGOON store (P 18 2) every 5 steps: a dynamic line is now written like the other types, REEF3D_CFD_6DOF_Mooring/REEF3D-Mooring-<line>-<output>.vtk with its Tension (the inner force of the beam at each node; before only REEF3D_CFD_Beam had it, which LAGOON does not read), and the particle set cfd_mooring holds the same points, segments and Tension.
